items.heading: Pick the Proof
items.text: Pick the proof you can honestly build. A small, real tracker beats a long list of adjectives.

items.heading: A Tracker Is the Simplest
items.text: A tracker is the simplest proof of HR process skill. Build it with sample data, never with real candidate details.

items.heading: Run a Practice Interview
items.text: Run a practice interview with a friend as the candidate and record your own work.
